CA.rationale: No explicit attention/allocation relation linked to identified content was present.

COD.rationale: Content coordinates (red) and an explicit origin/status (history_estimate) and grid presentation statement are all present for the same current referent, allowing content, organization/access and status distinctions to be bound together; scope across evidence is mixed, so binding scope marked unclear.

A.rationale: No explicit attention or allocation statement linked to the identified contents' presentation/access is present.

C.rationale: Multiple explicit content listings identify specific colored positions for named referents and times (current and candidate), fulfilling content+attribute identification.

D.rationale: The report separately specifies identified content (coordinates) and an explicit origin/status entry for the same referent/time, distinguishing content from its organization/access/status.

O.rationale: The text states how contents are organized/presented (grid orientation) and supplies explicit origin/access metadata for contents (history_estimate, command_estimate) for current and candidate entries.
